building.cmd.plot: /aplot new | remove | list - mark a new plot in architect mode, take away the plot you stand on with everything on it, or list the plots
building.cmd.build: /abuild - open architect mode on the plot you stand on, or choose a plot around or mark a new one
building.not_in_world: You have to be in the world to build.
building.no_plot_here: You are not standing on a plot. Mark one with /aplot new.
building.already_open: You are in architect mode already.
building.plot_failed: The plot could not be saved. Try again in a moment.

building.plot_removed.one: Plot #{id} is gone, and its {count} piece with it.
building.plot_removed.other: Plot #{id} is gone, and its {count} pieces with it.

building.plot_remove_failed: Plot #{id} could not be taken away and is still there. Try again in a moment.
building.plot_entry: #{id}: {area}, {kind}, {width} by {depth} tiles, pieces: {pieces}, price {price} gold, tax {tax} gold a week
building.malformed: Your game sent something the server cannot read. Try again.
building.too_big: A plot is at most {most} tiles a side.
building.form_invalid: The plot's kind, price, tax or height is not right.
building.sign_far: The plot's sign has to stand at its edge, on its ground.
building.overlaps: The plot would cover another plot.
building.undo_nothing: Nothing to undo on this plot.
building.outside: That does not fit on the plot.
building.too_high: That reaches above the plot's height of {metres} m.
building.unknown_piece: The catalogue has no such piece.
building.gone: That piece is not there any more.
building.change_failed: That could not be saved. Try again in a moment.
building.no_cell: The world here is not loaded on the server yet, so that cannot be made. Try again in a moment.
building.not_yours: That is not yours to do in architect mode.
building.plot_gone: Plot #{id} is not there any more.
building.plot_far: Plot #{id} is more than {metres} m from you.
building.sign_moved: The plot's sign stands at its new front.
building.break_outside: A part of it would stand off the plot.
building.break_too_many: That is more than {most} parts, too many to take apart.
building.sale_bought: Plot #{id} is yours, for {price} gold. Its tax is {tax} gold a week.
building.sale_too_poor: Plot #{id} costs {price} gold, and you carry {gold}.

building.sale_too_many.one: You own a plot already, and a character owns at most {count}.
building.sale_too_many.other: You own {count} plots already, as many as a character may.

building.sale_busy: Your purchase is still being written.
building.sale_failed: The plot could not be bought. Your gold is back in your purse.
building.sale_lost: The plot could not be bought, and your gold could not be given back. Tell the staff.
building.sale_closed_far: The sign's window closed: you went more than {metres} m from it.
building.sale_closed_gone: The sign's window closed: the plot is gone.
building.sale_closed_not_in_world: The sign's window closed: you left the world.
building.closed_off_duty: Architect mode closed: you are off duty.
building.closed_far: Architect mode closed: you went more than {metres} m from the plot.
building.closed_gone: Architect mode closed: the plot is gone.
building.closed_not_in_world: Architect mode closed: you left the world.
